home.sosSubtitle: Alerts nearby ambulances and the community desk

web.heroTitle: Doctors, medicines, lab tests and a 24×7 SOS for every home
web.heroBody: {{brand}} brings home healthcare to gated communities, apartments, families, senior-living homes and employers.

console.title: {{brand}} console
console.signInPrompt: Staff sign in with email and two-factor authentication.
console.notStaff: This account has no console access. Ask a super admin to add a role.
console.mfaEnrollBody: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or similar), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
console.mfaVerifyBody: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
console.wrongCode: That code didn't work. Codes change every 30 seconds; try the current one.

auth.phoneTitle: Sign in with your mobile number
auth.whatsappNotice: We'll also send booking and service updates on WhatsApp. Reply STOP at any time to stop them.
auth.wrongCode: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.
auth.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
auth.genericError: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
auth.resendIn: You can ask for a new code in {{seconds}} s
auth.useSms: Get the code by SMS instead
auth.fieldOnly: This app is for field staff. Ask your supervisor to add your number, then sign in again.

consent.screenBody: You decide who sees your health information. You can change any of these later in Profile → Privacy.

care_record.title: Keep my health record
care_record.body: Store my readings, conditions, allergies, medicines and reports so the app can show them to me and provide the services I ask for. Nobody else sees them unless I allow it below or when booking.

emergency_share.title: Share my records with the hospital in an emergency
emergency_share.body: If I raise an SOS, send my blood group, allergies, conditions, medicines, last readings, emergency contacts and insurance to the receiving hospital through a secure link that expires. If this is off, only my blood group is sent.

family_sos_alert.title: Alert my family on every SOS
family_sos_alert.body: Tell my emergency contacts that an SOS was raised and when help is on the way. They never receive medical details.

proactive_care.title: Let the care team watch over my readings
proactive_care.body: The care team may review my readings and contact me if something looks wrong or a check-up is due. If this is off, I am never included in risk lists or alerts.

reminders.title: Medicine reminders
reminders.body: Remind me when a dose is due.

manager.title: Let {{name}} manage my care
manager.body: {{name}} can see my health record, book services and record readings for me. Everything they do is recorded, and I can remove them at any time.

doctor_share.title: Share with the doctor
doctor_share.body: The doctor sees only what I tick here, for this consult only.
